fact: The Chief Justice of Nigeria launched the Nigerian Case Management System at the Supreme Court on 1 July 2026, with phase one requiring counsel to upload electronic copies of processes and records for pending appeals set for hearing September to December 2026.

The Chief Justice said the NCMS will expand quarterly until all pending Supreme Court appeals are captured, and the Judicial Information Technology Policy Committee chairman said it is designed to link High Courts, the National Industrial Court and the Sharia and Customary Courts of Appeal to the Court of Appeal and Supreme Court.
